name: use-audit
title: useAuditLog
description: useAuditLog: the audit block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the audit block (`npx better-supabase add audit`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/audit.
